visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white line engraving depicting four figures in 18th-century attire gathered in a rocky, cave-like setting. One man stands to the left, looking away, while another man sits on a rock to the right, holding an open book and gesturing as if reading aloud. Two women sit between them, listening. The style is characteristic of late 19th-century book illustration.
